metas.name: 1. Homer's Crossing
metas.description: Feeling worthless at work, Homer volunteers to be a school crossing guard. But when his safety squad receives too much funding, the crossing guards become a force to be feared.

metas.name: 2. A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
metas.description: Marge feels an overwhelming dread of the empty nest.

metas.name: 3. McMansion & Wife
metas.description: When a new neighbor showers him with kindness, Homer thinks he's being tricked into buying a sports car at the dealership where the neighbor works - but the truth turns out to be even more sinister; Lisa neutralizes Nelson after he goes on a bullying spree.

metas.name: 4. Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
metas.description: In a parody documentary, a young college-dropout CEO embraces the Silicon Valley "fake it until you make it" philosophy and bewitches Mr. Burns into funding her highly dubious dream project.

metas.name: 5. Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
metas.description: After Bart is turned into an NFT, Marge fights though the blockchain to rescue her son. To track down a gruesome serial killer, Lisa turns to a murderer from her past. An outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

metas.name: 6. Iron Marge
metas.description: When Marge's heart is broken by a bad birthday present, Bart and Lisa must dig into their mom's past to show that they really know her. Homer becomes a neighborhood fear-monger.

metas.name: 7. It's a Blunderful Life
metas.description: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

metas.name: 8. AE Bonny Romance
metas.description: When Groundskeeper Willie is kidnapped to Scotland, Bart and the Simpsons follow - only to discover that what awaits is Homer's worst nightmare.

metas.name: 9. Murder, She Boat
metas.description: Lisa must solve a closed-boat mystery when Comic Book Guy's million-dollar action figure is "murdered" on a pop culture cruise.

metas.name: 10. Do the Wrong Thing
metas.description: Homer and Bart become kings of the blue-collar sports circuit, but Marge suspects something dishonest at the core of their father-son bond.

metas.name: 11. Frinkenstein's Monster
metas.description: Professor Frink secretly helps Homer, through a zoom interview, land a high-level position at a state-of-the-art nuclear plant in Shelbyville. But since Homer lacks the skills to actually perform the job, Frink must monitor Homer's work situation remotely and dictate his every wo

metas.name: 12. Lisa Gets an F1
metas.description: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

metas.name: 13. Clan of the Cave Mom
metas.description: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

metas.name: 14. Night of the Living Wage
metas.description: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she (collectively) bargained for.

metas.name: 15. Cremains of the Day
metas.description: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

metas.name: 16. The Tell-Tale Pants
metas.description: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

metas.name: 17. The Tipping Point
metas.description: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.
